verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents M2M applications that issue API access credentials for programmatic clients, and AuthKit acts as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server for MCP/agent access, so it can issue credentials an agent could use. However, no evidence shows those credentials can be narrowed to specific scopes or permissions. RBAC permissions are documented only for user roles and session JWTs, and the WorkOS MCP server gives agents the same dashboard access as the user rather than least-privilege access. Missing for 10: documented per-credential scopes/permissions for M2M or agent tokens, least-privilege controls for agent access to the WorkOS API itself, token lifetime/revocation details, and hands-on corroboration.
